### E&F Currency Merge -- GENERATED FILE, DO NOT EDIT
### Rebuild with tools/regen_ef_currency_merge.py after any E&F or hotfix update.
###
### One line, and it is deliberate.
###
### E&F's own bank companies are left exactly as E&F wrote them. They must NOT
### have building_bank in their building_types: a company can only own building
### types on its own list, and that list is the only real lock on who ends up
### holding the central bank. While they had it, Banca d'Italia privatised 4
### levels of the Papal central bank away from the company that held the
### monopoly -- a monopoly is a price and construction rule, not a lock.
###
### The central bank belongs to the generated per-currency companies and to
### nobody else. See zz_ef_cm_generic_banks.txt.
###
### company_BasicBank is the exception: it is the fallback owner for a country
### that has neither a currency law nor an entry in E&F's tag list, and a company
### cannot be given a building type that is not on its list -- create_building
### with add_ownership fails PostValidate at load and the bank never appears. It
### carries no currency, so it competes with nothing.

INJECT:company_BasicBank = {
	building_types = {
		building_bank
	}
}
